# Mixed Domain Collection

> > A collection spanning internet culture documentation from Know Your Meme, Google support resources, and Scientific American content.

This site aggregates content from multiple domains including Know Your Meme's viral meme encyclopedia, Google's Gmail support documentation, and Scientific American's science journalism. The primary focus appears to be on documenting and explaining internet culture, viral trends, and TikTok phenomena.

## Key Topics

- Know Your Meme
- TikTok trends
- Viral memes
- Internet culture
- Catchphrases
- Exploitable memes
- Image macros
- Social media platforms (Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook)
- Meme explanations
- Internet slang
- Gmail support
- Google Account
- Scientific American

## Meme Database & Reference

- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White and Jesse Pinkman
- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme entry featuring heartbreaking cat/kitten artwork
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's Atlanta rap song
- [Millennial Burger Place | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/millennial-burger-place): Millennial burger restaurant cliche meme and TikTok starter pack trend
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok
